title: Warehouse Modernization (Insurance)
subtitle: Teradata + DataStage + Cognos → Azure + Databricks
description: A 180 TB Teradata enterprise warehouse loaded by IBM DataStage and reported through Cognos. Moving to Azure Databricks to reduce licensing cost with strict governance for regulatory reporting.
